title_zh: 约定不再拿朋友的面试失利开玩笑

scenario.label_zh: 承认伤人玩笑并约定停止
scenario.goal_zh: 听取朋友对公开玩笑的不满，承认伤害并约定不再提起且先询问所需支持

context_zh: 两位英国朋友基特与阿什私下谈到聚会上的一句玩笑。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Can we talk about what you said at dinner? The joke about my failed interview felt nasty.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: I thought we were laughing about it together. I didn't realise you were upset.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: I told you because you're my mate, not because I wanted everyone else to hear it.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: You're right. I should have kept it private. I'm sorry.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: I know you've been a loyal friend. That's why I wanted to tell you rather than just avoid you.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: I won't bring it up again. Would it help if I checked in about the next interview, or would you prefer not to discuss it?

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Ask me privately first. Some days I want to talk; other days I don't.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Understood. I'll ask, and I'll respect it if the answer is no.

targets.sense_zh: 忠诚可靠的；始终支持的
